issues: Drawer does not close on ESC key — only via the X close button or backdrop click. Adding ESC-to-close would match standard drawer UX.

'MOSTLY LIVE · 100 sample / 271 real' banner sits directly above the Niche Markets H1 which is unrelated to this module — belongs to a global layout stripe. Consider hiding/updating when on /niche-markets since all 45 targets here are real named companies (is_sample=false).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/niche_markets.py::_ensure_seed() only seeds when count_documents({}) == 0. If seed list ever grows (e.g. new bench targets), existing DBs will never receive them. Consider an upsert-by-name/vertical pattern or a version stamp so seed additions land in existing environments.

battle_card / pitch endpoints call _claude() with no timeout guard on the emergentintegrations LlmChat. If Claude hangs, the FastAPI request will stall. Wrap in asyncio.wait_for(...) with ~90s timeout and translate to HTTP 504 for clean UX.

PitchIn model does not validate the `email` field format — the endpoint only checks '@ in email' at send time. A pydantic EmailStr (Optional) would 422 early rather than 400 at execution and would prevent obviously-malformed drafts from ever reaching the AI call.

PATCH /targets/{tid} allows changing `phase` but does not gate stage transitions (e.g. can jump from 'target' straight to 'contracted'). Add a stage-order validation if you want the pipeline stats to remain meaningful.
outbound_emails inserts full HTML body every send — over time this collection will grow large. Consider TTL indexing (e.g. 180d) or storing only a hash/preview of the HTML.

NicheMarkets.jsx load() swallows all errors silently (`catch (_) {}`) — a failing /playbook or /dashboard call leaves the user staring at 'Loading niche market network…' forever. Surface a toast + retry button.
NicheMarkets.jsx delete flow has no confirm() prompt on Trash2 — accidental single-click loss of a hand-added target.
